label: D1 after an unrewarded visit to S1
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (99.6% of mass) when the reward input is 0, i.e. the previous trial was unrewarded; never fires after a rewarded trial, never at GO, and only rarely and weakly at D2. Within unrewarded D1 steps it is specific to the previous trial having reached S1: (prev_state == 1) gives dev P 0.50 / R 0.81 / F1 0.62; nearly all remaining activations are at the window first trial where prev_state is unknown (-1), so the recorded predicate uses prev_state != 2 (dev P 0.42, R 0.97, mass recall 0.995). It essentially does not fire after an unrewarded S2 visit. Everything in the predicate is observed. Magnitude and firing probability rise with consecutive losses (adding an unrewarded trial two back: precision 0.85, holds 50% of mass on 34% of activations), with episode progress (rate 0.8% in trials 0-9 vs 5.8% in 90-99; ep_trial >= 50 raises precision to 0.75), and with lower model value (no activity when value > 7.73). Precision is incomplete because many single unrewarded S1 visits early in the episode or at high value do not cross threshold.
